_WARNING: THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR VOLLEY GEOMETRY. Do NOT edit dimensions inside Fusion 360 — user parameters there are document-scoped and will silently drift across the nine documents. Change a value here, then regenerate the affected document from script. Fusion is authoritative for geometry and fit only; analysis/*.py remains authoritative for mass and performance. Fusion-computed masses are proxies (solid-copper stator, solid-aluminium CubeSats, steel standing in for NdFeB) and are deliberately excluded from this file.

DIFF THIS AGAINST THE REPO COPY BEFORE MERGING — the original may carry provenance fields or analysis-script cross-references not reproduced here.

_PROVENANCE.coordinate_frame: x = firing axis, positive toward the muzzle. Origin x=0 at the ESPA flange aft mating face. y = lateral (P = +y port, S = -y starboard). z = vertical, z=0 at the stator mid-plane.

envelope.reconciliation_note: SUPERSEDES the 1825 x 516 x ~1030 figure in EMOCD_CAD_Master_Plan.md. That earlier value was measured on the now-superseded single-file model (MOCD_Deployer_Assembly_v1, closed and archived) BEFORE the enclosure existed, before the ESPA interface was rebuilt from a flat plate into a ring flange, and before the cassette septum/pin corrections. Length and width grow by skin clearance plus 2 mm shell (1825->1839, 516->530). CAUTION: the height change (1030->940) is larger than skin thickness explains — the lower bound is now set by the flange ring (z=-230) and the upper by the radiator (z=+710); the earlier model's height is believed to have included annotation-plane text and a differently-measured follower-motor stack. FLAGGED FOR RE-VERIFICATION.
envelope.espa_grande_conflict: Longest dimension exceeds ESPA Grande's ~1270 mm class limit by ~44%. Open problem P9 — host claim must be re-scoped or the machine repackaged.

stator.end_turns_note: Omitted — correct for field and force computation, WRONG for packaging. Real racetrack ends wrap beyond the 90 mm active depth and are not in the envelope.
stator.layer_count_decision: OPEN — single vs two-layer is an unmade electromagnetic design decision. Single layer as drawn.

sled.provisional_note: The 6 mm chassis is a first-pass stiffness-driven design (0.0115 mm deflection under 3.7 kN inter-array attraction -- superseded, A12 gives 2.69 kN, so the deflection is conservative -- against a +/-0.05 mm gap budget) with NO structural FEA behind it. Sled mass from this geometry contradicts the 4.86 kg assumed by mass_properties.py and drives exit velocity. Open problems P5/P8. ANSYS analysis A4 must close this before any number downstream is locked.

magazine._document: EMOCD_Magazine_Cassette (one document, inserted twice; second instance is a 180-degree rotation about z through x=210.25, NOT a mirror — Fusion rejects mirror transforms for external references)
magazine.shell_construction_decision: OPEN — drawn as closed 4 mm panels (upper bound, and the mounting surface the silicon-steel septa need). mass_properties.py assumes a 6% fill open frame (lower bound). The ~4.8 kg difference is a real design decision, not an error.

brake.taper_purpose: Tapered pole entry is the 200 g deceleration limiter protecting the brittle sintered NdFeB bonding.
brake.provisional_note: Poles were lightened from solid blocks to 15 mm plates on structural reasoning alone. Magnetic sizing against the required pole area has NOT been done — pending the eddy-brake field check.

payload_3u.modelled_as: solid aluminium proxy — real 3U flight mass is 4 kg, NOT the Fusion-computed value

enclosure._document: EMOCD_Enclosure (NEW — the ninth document; this is the flight unit as seen from outside)
enclosure.muzzle_aperture_verified: point-containment probe on the satellite exit line returns OUTSIDE (open); probe above the aperture returns INSIDE (solid panel)
enclosure.aft_cutout_profile: horseshoe — the cutout breaches the panel's lower edge by design, because the flange OD extends below the belly line
enclosure.mass_note: The enclosure, radiator, and packaged avionics have NO line items in mass_properties.py. The dry-mass rollup is incomplete until they are added. Open problem P10.
